english.title: Food business operator offer relevant food for sale without providing ingredient or processing aid details
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a food business operator, in making the particulars of

(A)_[an ingredient,]_
(B)_[a processing aid,]_
(C)_[an ingredient derived from a substance or product,]_
(D)_[a processing aid derived from a substance or product,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY INGREDIENT OR PROCESSING AID..), in relation to a relevant food, available, failed to do so with a clear reference to the name of the substance or product listed in Annex II where the relevant

(E)_[ingredient]_
(F)_[processing aid]_

was derived from a substance or product listed in that Annex, and the particulars were made available otherwise than by means provided for in Regulation (EU) No 1169/2011
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 5(5), 10(1)(b) and 11 of the Food Information Regulations 2014.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
being a food business operator
in making the particulars of an ingredient or processing aid OR
an ingredient or processing aid derived from a substance or product in relation to a relevant food, available
failed to do so with a clear reference to the name of the substance or product listed in Annex II where the relevant ingredient or processing aid
was derived from a substance or product listed in that Annex, and the particulars were made available otherwise than by means provided for in FIC
